run_kernel_layer_norm_fwd_1pass: run the Triton fused kernel that computes layer normalization with optional gating and bias in a single pass
run_function_layer_norm_fwd: run the layer norm forward pass function that launches the fused Triton kernel with configurable group size and RMS norm mode
run_function_rms_norm_gated: run RMS normalization with gated activation (silu) on input tensor with optional bias and group-wise normalization
test_kernel_layer_norm_fwd_1pass: test the Triton kernel for layer normalization supporting bias, gating, RMS norm, and group-wise normalization
review_function_rms_norm_gated: review the RMS norm gated function that reshapes input, applies fused kernel, and restores original tensor shape
